# Already-formatted file passes --check.
sngl fmt --check formatted.sngl

# Unformatted file fails --check.
! sngl fmt --check unformatted.sngl

# Format in place and compare result.
cp unformatted.sngl input.sngl
sngl fmt input.sngl
cmp input.sngl expected.sngl

-- formatted.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- unformatted.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component   main ui {
    var   x   =   0
}

app.window {
}
-- expected.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
    var x = 0
}

app.window {
    main
}
